title: Food
blurb: Every edible item, with what it restores. Nutrition is the hunger points restored on eating; saturation is the hidden value that delays hunger from ticking down again.
note: Tier A. 44 items carry minecraft:food in 26.2. Icon borrowed from Bread, the archetypal food item. The hunger shank from data/curated/hud-sprites.json would say 'food' without picking one of the 44 items, but it is a 9x9 HUD sprite and every other icon in a window header and suggestion row is 16x16. It rendered visibly smaller than its neighbours, and scaling it up needs a non-integer 1.78x that would blur a pixel sprite.
